title: The triple forms of the coupled blocks
claim: On 3-surgery on the closure of s1^3 s2^3 ... s_{n-1}^3 times a full twist, for n = 6, 9, 12, the twisted triple product T (recovered up to scalar per block from the obstruction bimap through duality) splits into one inseparable block of F4-dimension d = 3, 5, 7 and n/3 - 1 trefoil-type singletons. On the inseparable block, the Bockstein part D(a) = T(a, a, .), a Frobenius-semilinear map V -> V*, has rank d - 1, and the alternating part is nonzero. The block counts are 244, 8176 and 367684, as in UT3-INTERACT-PROBE-20261026-001. These counts are not functions of the Bockstein part: in a fixed basis, keeping the entries T(e_i, e_i, e_k) (which transform among themselves under a change of basis) and changing only the entries with three distinct indices changes the count (d = 3: 784 when the distinct-index entry is 0, 244 when it is nonzero; d = 5: several values). So the family's counts reflect one choice of alternating part, which Borromean moves change freely (TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001C); no closed form for them was found.
failure_conditions: A recovered block form whose kernel count differs from the obstruction bimap's count, or whose singleton splitting fails.
A Bockstein rank other than d - 1 on the inseparable block, or a block count other than 244, 8176, 367684.
Counts that do not change when only the alternating part changes (the D-only control).
foundation_claim_scope: Exact computation on three manifolds of one family (n = 6, 9, 12); the n = 15 block (d = 9) is not identified. The decomposition into a Bockstein part and an alternating part is basis-dependent except for the Bockstein map up to semilinear congruence. No closed form for the block counts is claimed or excluded beyond the tested hypotheses. No complexity claim; no P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: exact recomputation of the three coupled blocks (recovered forms, singleton splitting, Bockstein ranks, counts and corank distributions) and the alternating-part control; no human or external review
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-26.
